title: What is ASP.NET Core and how does it differ from ASP.NET Framework?
description: Understand the modern cross-platform ASP.NET Core.

data.text: **Question:** What is ASP.NET Core and how does it differ from ASP.NET Framework?

ASP.NET Core is a modern, cross-platform, open-source web framework. Unlike the Windows-only ASP.NET Framework, ASP.NET Core runs on Windows, Linux, and macOS, offers better performance, and uses a modular middleware pipeline.

**ASP.NET Core:**
- Cross-platform (Windows, Linux, macOS)
- Open source on GitHub
- Modular HTTP pipeline with middleware
- Built-in dependency injection
- High performance (among fastest web frameworks)
- Unified MVC and Web API
- No System.Web dependency

**ASP.NET Framework:**
- Windows-only
- Closed source
- Uses System.Web and IIS
- Monolithic pipeline
- Web Forms, MVC, Web API separate
